claim: Opus One (Oakville) offers tiered appointment-only experiences: $150 Estate Tasting (rooftop terrace, two vintages + Overture), $250 Opus One Experience (Partners' Room, library wines + tour), and $793 Art of the Table four-course pairing.
quote: Opus One Experience Price: $250 per person ... Opus One Estate Tasting Price: $150 per person ... Art of the Table Price: $793 per person ... minimum of four guests

claim: Domaine Carneros (Carneros) is a French-style chateau specializing in methode traditionnelle sparkling and estate Pinot Noir, with seated terrace tastings overlooking Carneros hills and caviar/charcuterie pairings, by reservation daily.
quote: Reservations are required and are available daily beginning at 10:00am with the last reservation at 5:00pm.

claim: Castello di Amorosa (Calistoga, north of St. Helena) is an authentically-styled 14th-century Tuscan castle winery open by reservation only, offering tours, tastings and food-and-wine pairings daily 10am-5:30pm.
quote: Open by Reservation Only ... Daily: 10:00am-5:30pm ... authentically-styled 14th century Tuscan castle winery

claim: Castello di Amorosa, built by Dario Sattui and opened 2007, has 107 rooms over 8 levels (~141,000 sq ft after expansion) including a moat, drawbridge, defensive towers, courtyard, torture chamber, chapel and a great hall.
quote: 107 rooms on 8 levels above and below ground ... includes a moat, a drawbridge, defensive towers, an interior courtyard, a torture chamber, a chapel/church, a knights' chamber

claim: Quintessa (Rutherford/St. Helena) is a 280-acre organic and Biodynamic estate offering a ~$175 Communal Estate Experience and a ~$300 Quintessential Experience in a private open-air pavilion with library vintages and barrel samples, by reservation.
quote: Communal Estate Experience ... $175 per guest ... Quintessential Experience ... $300 per guest ... private, open-air pavilion surrounded by rolling vineyards ... organically and Biodynamic

claim: HALL St. Helena offers appointment tastings ranging from a $60 Flight Tasting and $75 Tour & Tasting to a $150 Cabernet Experience and $200 Platinum Tasting (max four guests).
quote: Platinum Tasting: $200 per guest ... Cabernet Experience ... $150 per person ... Flight Tasting ... $60 per person ... Tour & Tasting ... $75 per person

claim: HALL Rutherford, set amid the Sacrashe vineyard a few minutes from the St. Helena winery, offers a wine-and-food experience in its dramatic underground wine cave paired with top-tier wines.
quote: HALL Rutherford Wine Cave, with savory creations thoughtfully paired with their top tier wines

claim: Artesa Winery (Carneros) is a striking modern hilltop estate (2018 AIA Design Award) with panoramic views, sculptures and fountains, offering a $65 Terrace Seating five-wine tasting and a $105 guided tour with five wines, by reservation.
quote: guided tour includes a tasting of five wines for $105 per person ... Terrace Seating includes a tasting of five exclusive wines for $65 ... 2018 Design Award from the American Institute of Architects

claim: Domaine Chandon in Yountville itself offers sparkling wine tastings from roughly $36, plus private Garden Cabanas with Brut Rose and communal local dishes, with reservations 10am-4pm and walk-ins welcome subject to availability.
quote: Tastings and experiences are available from 10 AM - 4 PM by reservation, with walk-ins welcome based on availability ... Garden Cabanas are available as private spaces

claim: Robert Mondavi Winery (Oakville) reopens April 20, 2026 after multi-year renovation, offering the $95 Mondavi Table three-course pairing, $180 Pioneer Tasting, and a To Kalon Legend Tasting & Tour, by appointment.
quote: reopen to guests on April 20th, 2026 ... Pioneer Tasting ... $180 ... The Mondavi Table ... $95 ... The Legend Tasting & Tour ... To Kalon Reserve wines

claim: Across Napa Valley in 2026, standard tastings average $50-75 per person while premium/reserve experiences run $85-125+, and nearly all wineries require reservations 2-4 weeks ahead with many waiving fees on minimum wine purchases.
quote: Standard tastings in Napa Valley average $50-75 per person in 2026, while premium and reserve experiences run $85-125+ ... Nearly all Napa wineries require reservations

claim: Napa Valley Aloft charges $300 per person for its Premier group balloon experience, with private/large-group rates by phone and discounts for children, military and seniors.
quote: Premier Balloon Experience: $300 per person ... Discounts available for Children, Military and Seniors.

claim: Napa Valley Aloft balloon flights launch year-round just after dawn (meeting ~30 min before sunrise, roughly 5:30-7:00 a.m.) from 6525 Washington Street in Yountville, with a ~3-4 hour total commitment.
quote: meetings occur about thirty minutes before sunrise, with times varying throughout the year, ranging from 5:30 a.m. to 7:00 a.m. Passengers meet at 6525 Washington Street, in Yountville

claim: Napa Valley Aloft also operates under the Balloons Above the Valley and Napa Valley Balloons brands, primarily launching from V-Marketplace in central Yountville (~80% of days) and a Pope Valley site when Yountville is foggy.
quote: Yountville (Primary): V-Marketplace in the center of town - used approximately 80% of flight days ... North Napa Valley (Secondary): Pope Valley location used when Yountville has fog

claim: Napa Valley Bike Tours runs rental shops in Napa, Yountville and St. Helena along the paved car-free Vine Trail; the Yountville and Napa shops are about 9 miles apart on flat vineyard-view trail and reservations are highly recommended.
quote: The Yountville and Napa rental shops are 9 miles apart along the Vine Trail so you can enjoy an entirely flat, car-free bike ride with beautiful vineyard views. Reservations are highly recommended.

claim: The Napa Valley Vine Trail is a paved pedestrian/bike path planned to span 47 miles from Vallejo to Calistoga, with about 33 miles currently paved in disconnected segments including Yountville and Napa.
quote: will eventually span a total of 47 miles from Vallejo to Calistoga. Currently, 33 miles of the trail are completed and paved in disconnected segments

claim: Napa Valley Bike Tours rentals start around $45 for a full-day rental (road bikes, cruisers, electric and tandem available), with pedal-assist e-bike upgrades around $40.
quote: rentals start at $45 for a full-day rental with options including road bikes, cruisers, electric and tandem bikes ... upgrade to a pedal-assist E-Bike for just $40

claim: Robert Louis Stevenson State Park is a 5,272-acre undeveloped park 7 miles north of Calistoga whose trails climb to the summit of Mount St. Helena and connect south to Table Rock, the Palisades and the Oat Hill Mine Trail.
quote: 5,272-acre undeveloped park ... 7 miles north of Calistoga on Highway 29 ... ascend to the summit of Mount St. Helena ... Table Rock, the Palisades' volcanic cliffs, and a route to the Oat Hill Mine Trail

claim: Bothe-Napa Valley State Park is a 1,900-acre park with over 10 miles of trails through redwoods, oaks and madrones, offering year-round camping, hiking and seasonal swimming; the Redwood Trail/Ritchey Canyon is the top-rated hike.
quote: Over 10 miles of hiking trails among redwoods, maples, oaks and madrones ... 1,900 acre park ... best place to hike in Bothe-Napa Valley State Park is Redwood Trail and Ritchey Canyon

claim: Skyline Wilderness Park on the southeast edge of Napa has an interconnected network of more than 20 miles of trails through oak woodland and creek corridors, with the Lake Marie Trail a local favorite.
quote: interconnected network of more than 20 miles of paths ... tucked into the foothills on the southeast edge of Napa ... Lake Marie Trail, which is a local favorite

claim: Westwood Hills Park in Napa offers a moderate 1.8-mile trail climbing roughly 575 feet to open hillsides with panoramic views of vineyards and downtown Napa.
quote: The Westwood Hills Park trail is 1.8 miles with an elevation gain of 575 feet ... open hillsides with panoramic views of Napa's vineyards and downtown

claim: Napa Valley Paddle rents single kayaks and SUPs at $37/hr, tandem kayaks at $49/hr (2-hour minimum) from the Napa Yacht Club public ramp at 100 Riverside Drive in downtown Napa, by appointment Friday-Monday.
quote: Kayak (single): $37/hr ... Tandem Kayak: $49/hr ... 2-hour minimum ... 100 Riverside Drive at the Napa Yacht Club public ramp ... By appointment only, Friday - Monday

claim: Indian Springs Calistoga's signature 60-minute Mud Bath Ritual ($170) immerses guests in warm volcanic ash mixed with mineral water, followed by a mineral-water soak, infrared sauna, and flannel-blanket cool-down; classic 45-min mineral baths start at $105.
quote: Indian Springs Mud Bath Ritual (60 minutes): $170 ... immersion in warm volcanic ash mixed with mineral water, shower rinse, soak in pure mineral water ... infrared sauna time, and a cool-down wrapped in flannel blankets. Indian Springs Classic Mineral Bath (45 minutes): $105

claim: Indian Springs day spa guests pay $50 for pool access paired with a 50-minute service; the Olympic-size geothermal mineral pool runs 92-102 degrees F and the resort recently added a Himalayan salt halotherapy room and infrared saunas.
quote: day spa guests pay $50 paired with a 50-minute service ... main Olympic pool ranges between 92F in summer and 102F in winter ... new amenities including a beautiful Halotherapy Himalayan Salt Room ... full spectrum infrared saunas

claim: Dr. Wilkinson's Backyard Resort & Mineral Springs offers 'The Works' (mud bath, mineral whirlpool, facial mask and massage) and the 60-minute 'Mudslinger' (mud bath, Epsom-salt mineral whirlpool, geo-steam, facial mask, blanket wrap), with 25% off mud and mineral baths Monday-Friday.
quote: The Works, which includes mud bath treatment, mineral whirlpool bath, a facial mask, and massage ... The Mudslinger, a 60-minute treatment with mud bath, mineral whirlpool bath infused with Epsom salts, geo-steam room time, facial mask, and a blanket wrap ... 25% off mud and mineral baths Monday to Friday

claim: Golden Haven Hot Springs Spa specializes in couples/friends mud baths taken together in private treatment rooms (accommodating two to four people), combining hot mud, a mineral bath and a cool-down flannel wrap, often packaged with massage.
quote: combine a mud bath with a massage for the perfect Calistoga spa experience. Couples can enjoy all steps of the mud bath together in a private spa treatment room ... hot mud, a mineral bath, and a cool down flannel wrap

claim: Calistoga Spa Hot Springs has four geothermal mineral pools ranging 80-104 degrees F plus volcanic-ash mud baths (offered Thursday-Sunday); non-hotel guests can add outdoor pool access for $50 per guest with certain packages.
quote: four geothermal mineral pools. These pools range from 80 to 104 degrees ... Volcanic ash mud baths are available Thursday through Sunday ... non-hotel guests can add access to the outdoor geothermal mineral pools for $50 per guest

claim: The Old Faithful Geyser of California in Calistoga erupts every 15-30 minutes shooting water up to 60 feet; admission is $15 adults (12+), $13 seniors/military, $9 children 4-11, free under 4, and includes a geology museum, native-plant gardens with mineral fountains, and an animal farm.
quote: Every 15 to 30 minutes, the geyser erupts ... as high as 60 feet into the air ... Adults (12+): $15; Seniors (65+) and Military: $13; Children (4-11): $9; Children under 4: Free ... Geology Museum (included with admission) ... An animal farm and petting zoo

claim: The Petrified Forest in Calistoga is open daily 9am-5pm (arrive by 4pm to walk the trail) with admission of $14 adult, $13 senior, $8 junior, $6 child, and free under 6.
quote: Adult: $14.00; Senior: $13.00; Junior: $8.00; Child: $6.00; Under 6: Free ... Mon 9am-5pm through Sun 9am-5pm — open daily ... arrive by 4 if you would like to walk the trail

claim: Castello di Amorosa, a medieval Tuscan-style castle winery in Calistoga, requires reservations and runs daily 10am-5:30pm; options include a $60 Tasting (5 wines, self-guided main levels), the $75 Diamond Estate Tour & Wine Tasting (~1h50m guided tour of upper levels, dungeons and production area plus 5 wines, 21+), and a $115 Cheese & Charcuterie pairing tour.
quote: Diamond Estate Tour & Wine Tasting Price: $75 ... Guided tour of upper levels, dungeons, and production area plus 5 wine selections ... Tasting Experience Price: $60 ... Children (2-20): $25 ... Cheese & Charcuterie Wine Pairing Tour Price: $115 ... operates daily from 10:00 AM to 5:30 PM by reservation

claim: Yountville's restaurants, tasting rooms and shops line Washington Street for about three-quarters of a mile, making the downtown highly walkable.
quote: Tasting rooms, shops, and Yountville's main attraction—its many stellar restaurants—line Washington Street for ¾ mile between Madison Street and California Drive.

claim: V Marketplace occupies three 1870 stone winery buildings and now houses specialty shops, art galleries, restaurants and a wine-tasting cellar.
quote: V Marketplace is located in three 1870 stone buildings that once housed a winery, barrel room and distillery, and today it's home to restaurants, galleries and boutiques.

claim: Yountville's Art Walk is a self-guided, strollable collection of over 35 rotating outdoor sculptures along Washington Street, with maps and an audio tour from the Welcome Center.
quote: over 35 rotating outdoor sculptures from local and world renowned artists ... The Welcome Center provides Art Walk maps and audio tours for self-guided exploration

claim: The 14th annual Art, Sip & Stroll returns to downtown Yountville on May 16, 2026 with 80+ juried artists, wineries, live music and free admission.
quote: The 14th Annual Art, Sip & Stroll returns to downtown Yountville on May 16, 2026—with 80+ juried artists, Napa Valley wineries, live music, and free admission.

claim: RH Yountville offers dining under crystal chandeliers (charcuterie boards, burgers, lobster rolls, roasted chicken) plus the RH Wine Vault tastings in a 1904 stone building.
quote: RH Yountville offers dining under crystal chandeliers on cheese and charcuterie boards, a splendid burger, lobster rolls, roasted chicken ... RH Wine Vault is a historic 1904 stone building

claim: The Napa Valley Museum at 55 Presidents Circle, Yountville is open Tuesday-Sunday 10am-6pm, closed Mondays, with $5 adult admission and three rotating galleries.
quote: Hours are Tuesday-Sunday, 10am-6pm ... Admission is free for members, $5 for adults, $3.50 for seniors, $2.50 for youth under 17 ... located at 55 Presidents Circle, Yountville, CA 94599

claim: Thomas Keller's Bouchon Bistro in Yountville serves authentic French bistro fare and earned a Michelin star; its adjacent Bouchon Bakery offers baguettes, macarons and pastries.
quote: In 1998, Chef Thomas Keller decided to dedicate a new restaurant concept to authentic French bistro fare and opened The Bouchon Bistro ... led the Michelin Guide to award a star to Bouchon.

claim: Beyond The French Laundry, Keller runs Ad Hoc + Addendum (daily-changing family-style American comfort food) and La Calenda (Oaxacan-inspired Mexican) in Yountville.
quote: Ad Hoc + Addendum is a casual restaurant that features a family-style four-course menu that changes daily ... La Calenda ... draws inspiration from the Oaxacan region of Mexico.

claim: Non-Keller Yountville dining anchors include Philippe Jeanty's French Bistro Jeanty (opened 1998) and nearby Mustards Grill, Cindy Pawlcyn's long-running American grill.
quote: Bistro Jeanty ... casual spot with serious French comfort food ... Mustards Grill, owned by chef Cindy Pawlcyn for 30 years, knows how to put a sophisticated spin on hearty dishes.

claim: St. Helena's Model Bakery has operated since 1908 on Main Street, baking from 1920s ovens and famous for English muffins featured on Oprah's Favorite Things.
quote: Oprah has given Model Bakery her seal of approval with their English muffins ... the flagship store has been in business since 1908 with ovens from the 1920s where they make 5,000 English muffins every day.

claim: St. Helena, nicknamed Napa Valley's Main Street, has shops, galleries and cafes in historic buildings and marks its 150th anniversary in 2026.
quote: Nicknamed "Napa Valley's Main Street," the downtown area of St. Helena features lovely little shops, art galleries, and precious cafés set in historic buildings ... St. Helena marks its 150th anniversary

claim: The CIA at Greystone, a National Register historic former Christian Brothers winery in St. Helena, offers the Gatehouse Restaurant, The Bakery Cafe and the Spice Islands Marketplace store.
quote: Built in the late 19th century and listed on the National Register of Historic Places, Greystone in St. Helena was once home to the Christian Brothers Winery ... dining in the Gatehouse Restaurant, espresso and pastry from The Bakery Cafe, and shopping in the Spice Islands Marketplace.

claim: Beringer Vineyards at 2000 Main Street, St. Helena is Napa's oldest continuously operating winery (1876), with landscaped grounds and the ornate 1884 Victorian Rhine House to stroll.
quote: Beringer Vineyards is Napa Valley's oldest continuously operating winery, established in 1876 ... the 17-room Rhine House was built in 1884 ... sit on the expansive porch while taking in the gorgeously landscaped grounds.

claim: St. Helena is about 9.3 miles (15 km) from Yountville, roughly a 15-16 minute drive in normal traffic.
quote: The direct drive from Yountville to St. Helena is 9.3 miles (15 km), with a drive time of 15 minutes in normal traffic.

claim: Charles Krug at 2800 Main Street is Napa Valley's first winery (1861), offering estate tours, outdoor tastings and cheese/charcuterie on its grounds in St. Helena.
quote: Charles Krug winery was established by winemaker Charles Krug in 1861 as the Napa Valley's first winery ... options including outdoor tastings and artisan cheese and charcuterie.

claim: Oxbow Public Market is a 40,000-sq-ft food hall at 610 & 644 First St, Napa, open daily 7am-9pm with owner-operated local vendors and an outdoor deck on the Napa River.
quote: The local Gathering place for great food & wine in Napa Valley

claim: Oxbow Public Market vendors include Gott's Roadside, Eiko's sushi, El Porteno Empanadas and Hudson Greens & Goods, with live music, tastings and a farmers market.
quote: Oxbow Public Market | Napa, CA 94559

claim: The Napa Valley Wine Train departs from 1275 McKinstry Street, Napa, offering daytime, evening multi-course dinner, six-hour Legacy, and seasonal journeys in refurbished Pullman cars; reservations required via Check Availability.
quote: Multi-course gourmet meals, afternoon teas, and Michelin-inspired tastings are paired with stunning views and personalized service.

claim: The Wine Train runs a 36-mile, ~3-hour round trip from Napa to St. Helena through Yountville, Oakville and Rutherford; lunch trips start near $200/person and daylong tours can exceed $700.
quote: Ticket prices start around $200 per person for a lunch trip during the off season, and can exceed $700 per person for daylong tours.

claim: Downtown Napa on the Napa River has been reinvented with celebrity-chef restaurants, riverside parks and walks, and dozens of walkable tasting rooms.
quote: An influx of celebrity-chef restaurants, upscale lodgings, manicured parks and river walks, and dozens of tasting rooms have redefined the area as a luxury destination.

claim: More than 20 downtown Napa tasting rooms are within walking distance, including Robert Mondavi Arch & Tower, The River Club, and Vintner's Collective in a restored 19th-century stone building.
quote: There are more than 20 tasting rooms, all within walking distance of the Napa River Inn.

claim: di Rosa Center for Contemporary Art is open Friday-Sunday 11am-4pm (last admission 3:30); admission is $25 general, $20 senior/student/military, $5 ages 5-17, free under 5; guided tours offered Fri-Sun at 11am.
quote: Friday – Sunday 11 a.m. – 4 p.m. ... General: $25 ... Minors (5–17): $5 ... Members and children under 5: Free

claim: di Rosa sits on 217 acres at 5200 Sonoma Hwy in Carneros with over 1,600 Northern California artworks, two indoor galleries, a large outdoor sculpture meadow, a 35-acre lake and walking trails.
quote: the site features multiple galleries, a sculpture park, and a 35-acre lake, all located on 217 scenic acres

claim: CIA at Copia in Napa's Oxbow District (500 First Street) offers hands-on cooking and beverage classes, The Grove garden-to-table restaurant, self-service wine bar, marketplace, and the Chuck Williams Culinary Arts Museum.
quote: The Grove Restaurant featuring locally sourced, chef-driven cuisine ... Chuck Williams Culinary Arts Museum ... Wine Bar - Self-service wine tastings available throughout the property

claim: Napa Premium Outlets (629 Factory Stores Dr) is open daily 11am-7pm with extended hours during the November-January holiday season.
quote: Napa Premium Outlets regular hours of operation are Monday through Sunday, 11:00 AM - 7:00 PM.

claim: Napa Valley's two main north-south routes are Highway 29 (the primary thoroughfare from Napa city to Calistoga on the west side) and the less-traveled Silverado Trail on the east side; the valley floor is just 35 miles long and 5 miles wide, and Sonoma is about 15 miles (24 km) away.
quote: The valley floor between the mountain ranges is just 35 miles long and 5 miles across at its widest point. Sonoma to Napa Valley: 15 miles / 24 km.

claim: Yountville to Napa city is about 9 miles (14 km), roughly 16 minutes; Yountville to Rutherford ~5 miles (8 km), ~8 min; Yountville to Oakville ~4 miles, ~6 min; Yountville to Sonoma ~21 miles (34 km), ~29 min by road.
quote: It's 9 miles or 14 km from Yountville to Napa, which takes about 16 minutes to drive.

claim: Yountville to St. Helena is about 10 miles, roughly a 14-minute drive, and Calistoga to Yountville is about 18 miles (29 km), roughly 28 minutes.
quote: The driving distance between Yountville and St. Helena is 10 miles, taking approximately 14 minutes to drive.

claim: Highway 29 is a divided freeway as far as Yountville, after which it narrows to a two-lane road through the upvalley wine towns, making it slower and more congested than the parallel Silverado Trail on weekends.
quote: Highway 29 is a divided freeway as far as Yountville, after which it becomes a two-lane road.

claim: Car-free options include Vine Transit (hourly daytime buses connecting Highway 29 towns but not reaching rural wineries), biking the paved Napa Valley Vine Trail between Napa and Yountville, and private drivers from $60-$90 per hour with minimums; rideshare coverage is inconsistent north of St. Helena or after dark with 15-25 min waits and no guaranteed return rides.
quote: coverage is inconsistent, especially north of St. Helena or after dark... wait times of 15-25 minutes are common, and return rides from remote wineries aren't guaranteed.

claim: A common Napa model is hiring a properly insured 'designated driver' who drives the client's own vehicle on a wine tour, typically around $60 per hour with a five- or six-hour minimum, sidestepping DUI risk.
quote: For a properly insured designated driver, expect to pay around $60 per hour with a five or 6 hour minimum.

claim: As of 2026 a new Vine UpValley Link program reimburses half of rideshare (Uber/Lyft) spending for eligible disabled or 65+ residents of Calistoga, St. Helena and Yountville, reflecting limited upvalley transit coverage.
quote: the authority will reimburse half of what's spent on rideshare services such as Uber or Lyft by eligible residents — people living in Calistoga, St. Helena and Yountville who are disabled or age 65 or older.

claim: Harvest (crush) season runs August through October and is the peak season for visiting Napa Valley; sparkling grapes are picked first in early August, whites mid-August to September, and Cabernet last in late October-November, with wineries hosting harvest parties; advance reservations are advised.
quote: Harvest season is peak season for visiting Napa Valley, during August through October... make reservations in advance for wine tastings and dining.

claim: The busiest and most expensive window is weekends during harvest from mid-September to late October; spring shoulder season (March-May) is quieter with more attentive tastings; November-March is the budget low season with sunny 50s days and fewer crowds; summer (June-August) brings heat and packed crowds.
quote: the absolute worst time to visit is on a weekend during harvest season, specifically from mid-September to late October... For a more relaxed and personal tasting experience, aim for the shoulder season of March to May.

claim: In 2026 the average Napa tasting fee runs $50-75 per person: walk-in bar flights $25-40, seated hosted tastings $40-75, and premium/reserve experiences $85-125+, with some wineries now charging $100 or more; nearly all wineries require reservations (book 2-4 weeks ahead) and many waive fees with a 2-bottle or $75+ purchase.
quote: The average tasting fee in Napa Valley is $50-75 per person... Nearly all Napa wineries require reservations in 2026. Book 2-4 weeks ahead for popular estates.
